lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple vertical lines, specifically those in the mid-lateral region (indices 4 through 8 from anterior), exhibit distal fragmentation and terminate as discrete spots before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 8-10 white spots is localized on the lower haunch and the proximal portion of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct horizontal rows of spots are aligned across the mid-to-lower flank, intersecting the primary vertical line topology.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white circular spots are visible on the cheek; white transverse bands are present on the upper forelimbs and hind limbs; tail ventral surface exhibits high-contrast white pelage.
